scope: PL v4.5 owner report: the Ep. 2 mission title in the mission-select bottom bar ran into the mission-counter badge. Every mission title (303 menu slots + 224 *_ext.dat copies) was measured; 24 menu titles exceeded 32 cells. All are shortened to <=32 cells with their *_ext.dat copies kept identical, 48 rows in total.
source_binding: Every change is bound to the EN row source hash; runtime_tested stays false until the owner re-tests the v4.5 kit.

measurements.method: Column ink profile of the owner screenshot (2026-10-24): the 35-character Ep. 2 title spans 774..1935 image px = 251 screen px, i.e. 7.17 px per character; the (8) badge starts at 1969 image px. Titles are rendered left-aligned from the same x on every mission, so the cap is uniform.
measurements.original_jp_check: JP titles are full-width and stay under the cap by construction (longest JP menu title is 22 characters = 44 half-width cells, drawn in a list box, not this bar); only the bottom bar is tight.
measurements.hypothesis: The remaining margin is calibrated on one screenshot of one mission; a different badge set (e.g. longer right-hand labels) could still crowd a 32-cell title. No runtime confirmation yet.
